issues.issue: Whether an internal flight alternative is viable for the appellant in Nigeria
issues.applicant_position: Cannot return: fears persecution for his bisexual orientation across Nigeria.
issues.result_text: Same-sex activity is illegal nationwide, rebutting state protection and negating any viable IFA.

issues.issue: Whether the appellant is a Convention refugee based on sexual orientation, and whether his other profile matters
issues.applicant_position: Alleges fear for his bisexual orientation and for his other redacted profile.
issues.result_text: Refugee status granted for membership in a particular social group (non-heterosexual orientation); other profile not considered.
